text: Figure 5.38: Compatibiliy checks for DataMapping between DataPrototypes typed by an ApplicationDataTypeand a SystemSignal For a DataPrototype that is only typed by an ImplementationDataType and for which a DataTypeMap to an ApplicationDataType is not defined the compatibility rules in this chapter are not applicable. The reason for this restriction is that a Sys- temSignal defines physicalProps that can be checked against properties that are defined on ApplicationDataType level. Please also note that the specification items and constraints in this section are only valid for data for which the DataTransformation is not used or in which the data is transformed by the COM Based T ransformer (see [TPS_SYST_02058]). Another restriction is that those rules only cover the Sender-Receiver Communication.
